summary.name: RowSpeak
summary.one_liner: RowSpeak (also listed as Excelmatic) is an AI data analytics tool that turns Excel, CSV, PDF table and image files into charts, dashboards and reviewable reports from plain-English questions.
keywords: analyze exports from stripe or crm
use_cases: build a sales dashboard from an order spreadsheet
automate monthly variance and close reports
combine campaign exports from several ad platforms
prepare executive summaries from business exports
summary.what_it_does: RowSpeak lets you upload spreadsheets, CSV files, PDF tables, screenshots or business exports and ask questions in plain English. It reads the files, maps columns such as date, region, product and amount, and produces charts, KPI tiles, dashboards and report-ready summaries. The page shows examples of flagging unusual movements and explaining changes between periods. Saved questions and checks can be re-run automatically when an updated file arrives, with outputs exported to PDF, XLSX, CSV, image or PowerPoint. The page says users can correct key assumptions such as revenue field, date range or chart type before sharing.
notable: Recurring workflows: save questions and checks once, re-run on each new file
Can be deployed on-premise with open-source LLMs
Files are stated to be encrypted and not used to train AI models
Exports to Excel, CSV, image, PowerPoint and PDF
caveats: Direct connectors to Google Analytics, Google Sheets and databases are stated as coming soon, so only file uploads work today
Free tier stated as 10 conversations a month; further usage implies paid plans, with details not shown on the page
On-premise deployment requires contacting the vendor and a demo
